limits: Agreement is with saved exporter values, not proven game truth; PoB2 has independent known bugs.
The 51-build cohort was investigated. The additional 179 were measured, not individually triaged in this round.
Classification changes include documented reference differences and improved diagnostics; they are not counts of bugs fixed.
CSV missing before/after values mean that side was within tolerance; they do not assert exact equality to its reference.
Import/calculation success and zero reported missing items do not prove lossless import or browser UI correctness.
Unsupported and unread inventories can include inactive mechanics or alternate handling paths; they are not implementation backlogs.
Holdout attribution used aggregate rollback measurements only; no individual holdout was inspected.
Reference-condition calculations omit exporter-absent Mark Effect; its normal calculation is covered by focused and batch tests.
